notes.title: 《Immoral-Bathhouse》 A place to cleanse your soul… or defile your body
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/d275ad9eb71106d784aefd32f6c677115b38854a.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734630/_/?beta=1

[h2][b]Game Overview[/b][/h2]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/e50c4653d922e3b51a78a379a6deec383625be7b.png[/img]

You play as Ryuuji, a man who, due to a series of unfortunate events, has contracted a mysterious illness. After being drugged by his own father and burdened with his debts, Ryuuji discovers that his condition requires regular release through contact with female hormones to avoid worsening symptoms. To manage his finances and treat his condition, he takes over the management of the Tenryuu Bathhouse. By earning income through the bathhouse, he upgrades its interior, expands services, and raises its reputation to attract a wider range of customers.
However, when Ryuuji’s libido spikes due to his illness, he must take action. Using his role as the bathhouse owner, he attempts to lure in seven different female protagonists, each with distinct backgrounds, as customers. Through repeated interactions, he gradually builds deeper emotional and physical connections with them.

[h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/1b48c3a0dc57f3d9c1d0943a36fb96d608411039.gif[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/f1e2ca2be3a73de686c3c6bfe33b2bab5855a6aa.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/9bbc6159c17830c528e0a78dfdb3d283d1a0b191.png[/img]

In addition to managing the bathhouse for profit, players can venture into remote mountain areas to gather otherworldly herbs, craft special medicines, and sell them at high prices. There are also various other ways to earn money. Each in-game day is divided into four time periods, during which players can explore different areas, interact with various characters, obtain information, and engage in exchanges to improve income potential and increase favorability with the heroines.
If Ryuuji’s illness is left untreated, he will collapse and be rushed to the emergency room the next day, resulting in a significant financial loss or even death. Players must constantly monitor his physical condition to avoid tragic consequences.

After leaving home and finally reaching my destination, I was told the dungeon had already been conquered on the very same day?!
Fireworks lit up the sky in celebration, with singing, dancing, and wine flowing freely. I had hoped to ride the fame of "conquering the dungeon" to prove my worth to my family, only to witness another party complete the mission on the day I arrived.
With no other choice, I shifted my focus and headed to a nearby village called Meadow Village to gather news of any newly discovered dungeons. But upon learning that I was born in Grave, a region known for its virility boosting magical beasts, the village chief under the guise of helping me promote my name roped me into raising the village’s visibility (somehow?!).
While living in the village, I found myself growing unexpectedly close to the women around me: the charmingly manipulative guild receptionist, the shy but mysterious daughter of the item shop, the weapon obsessed blacksmith apprentice, the gentle and graceful single mother tavern owner, and the unpredictable magic shop owner who keeps trying to make a move on me.
